arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Draw one smooth 2D cartoon game prop. One extremely slender fishing rod extending from a THICKER reddish-brown butt at LOWER RIGHT to its THIN black/dark tip at FAR LEFT. It bows gently upward across the left/middle, then down toward right. Preserve first source's very shallow arch and thin width. A few tiny line-guide loops project just above the shaft at original locations. No visible reel, no large handle, no line added outside source silhouette. FIRST original image governs geometry, orientation and included parts; second image ONLY matching warm-brown wood, subtle amber light, silver metal, clean dark outline and restrained cel shading. Do not inherit second image's pose or extra mechanical parts. Redraw pixel steps as clean continuous curves, not pixel art. Preserve extremely slender relative thickness, do not turn it into a branch. True transparent alpha PNG; no scenery/floor/shadows/glow/text. Entire shape inside canvas with 5% margin.
